constraints.expression: length(trim(name))>0 AND version>0 AND template IN ('PROJECT','TEAM','ISSUE','MEETING')

length(trim(title))>0 AND status IN ('WAITING','WORKING','BLOCKED','DONE','CANCELLED') AND priority IN ('LOW','NORMAL','HIGH','URGENT') AND (starts_on IS NULL OR ends_on IS NULL OR starts_on<=ends_on) AND progress BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND (status!='DONE' OR progress=100) AND (status IN ('DONE','CANCELLED') OR progress<100) AND version>0 AND parent_id IS DISTINCT FROM id
